description: The Bank of Punjab was constituted pursuant to the BOP Act, 1989 and was given the status of a scheduled bank by the State Bank of Pakistan in 1994. It is principally engaged in commercial banking and related services, with its head office in Lahore, and its portfolio covers retail, consumer finance, agriculture, SME and corporate banking as well as Islamic banking windows. Punjab Modaraba Services (Pvt) Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of the bank.
headOffice: BOP Tower, 10-B, Block E-II, Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan
